subject: general
question: Which language institution gives away the Bhasha Bharti Samman award in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Institute of Indian Languages.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIIL)** in **Mysore **is governed by the **Ministry of Human Resource Development.**
 
• In order to support the creation and implementation of the Indian government's language policy, it was **founded **in **1969**.
 
• It was also meant to coordinate the **development **of **Indian languages **by pursuing research in the areas of** language analysis, language education, language technology, **and **language use in society.**
 
• The** Bhasha Bharati Samman Award** is given out annually by the **CIIL **to **authors **of **books **or other works that have been published in any of the Indian languages included in the Constitution's Eighth Schedule. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The **Sahitya Akademi**, the **Official Academy of Letters of India**, presents the **Bhasha Samman**, an annual literary award, to Indian authors who publish works in regional languages other than the 24 national languages of India.
 
• The honour comes with a **copper plaque **and a **cash prize **of **one lakh **Indian **rupees**.
 
• For their contributions to the growth of their respective languages and their literature, the first Bhasha Samman awards were given to **Dharikshan** **Mishra **for **Bhojpuri**, **Bansi Ram Sharma **and** M.R. Thakur** for **Himachali**, **K. Jathappa Rai** and **Mandara Keshava Bhat** for **Tulu**, and **Chandra Kanta Mura Singh **for **Kokborok. **
